works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 团队绩效追踪 App：目标进度、任务完成率与成员表现收在一块深色仪表盘里，环形进度与排行榜一眼分出高低；管理工具用“一块仪表盘 + 一张排行榜”把团队状态讲得清清楚楚。
works.comment_en: A team performance tracking app: goals, task completion and member stats share one dark dashboard, where ring charts and a leaderboard make highs and lows obvious at a glance; one dashboard and one leaderboard lay out the whole team's status.
works.title: Team Performance Tracking App

works.author: Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 制造执行 Web 应用 TraceRocket：生产订单、设备状态与质检数据排在浅色工作台上，时间线与进度条把车间运转可视化；工业 SaaS 用“一条产线时间线 + 一组设备状态”把工厂搬上屏幕。
works.comment_en: TraceRocket, a manufacturing web app: production orders, machine status and quality data sit on a light workbench, with timelines and progress bars making the shop floor visible; one production timeline and one set of machine states bring the factory onto the screen.
works.title: Manufacturing Web App Design - TraceRocket

works.author: Ronas IT
works.comment: 健身平台网站：深色首屏上课程、教练与会员计划层层展开，大号标题配力量感十足的训练摄影；健身品牌用“一幅训练大图 + 一组课程卡片”把“来练”说得直接有力。
works.comment_en: A fitness platform website: classes, coaches and membership plans unfold under a dark hero, with big headlines over powerful training photography; one large training image and a set of class cards make "come train" direct and punchy.
works.title: Gym Website Design - Fitness Platform

works.author: Rylic Studio
works.comment: 可持续牙科护理品牌 Oralux 着陆页：柔和的米白与绿色贯穿全页，产品、环保理念与订阅方案排得干净舒展；健康品牌用“一种温柔配色 + 一个环保故事”把牙科护理讲得清新可信。
works.comment_en: Oralux, a sustainable dental wellness landing page: soft off-white and green run through the page, with products, eco values and subscription plans laid out cleanly; one gentle palette and one sustainability story make dental care feel fresh and credible.
works.title: Oralux - Sustainable Dental Wellness Landing Page

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: 信用卡 App：卡片、账单与消费分析收在一部手机里，深色卡面配彩色图表层次分明；金融 App 用“一部手机 + 一张卡”把额度、账单与花销一次讲清。
works.comment_en: A credit card app: card, bills and spending analysis fit on one phone, with a dark card face and colorful charts keeping the layers distinct; one phone and one card make limits, bills and spending clear at once.
works.title: Credit Card App UI/UX — Fintech Design

works.author: Nexux Lab
works.comment: AI 保险与健康 App Merit：保单、健康评分与 AI 建议收在一个清爽的移动界面里，绿色点缀透着安心；保险产品用“一个健康分 + 一条 AI 建议”把保障讲得像日常健康管理。
works.comment_en: Merit, an AI insurance and wellness app: policies, a health score and AI suggestions share a clean mobile interface, with green accents that feel reassuring; one health score and one AI suggestion make insurance read like everyday health care.
works.title: Merit — AI Insurance & Wellness Mobile App
